greeting.text: Hi traveller, just arrived in the Feria? Perfect timing - the exhibits are only getting better as the day goes on.

choices.text: Can you tell me about the feria?

about_feria.text: It's a celebration - a thousand years of Milkantis, if the reckoning's to be believed.

about_feria_exhibits.text: Every exhibit's a homage to some piece of it: the cultures and building styles that grew up across the land, the landscapes, the artifacts we've built along the way - codigos, redstone work, that sort of thing - and the eras that carried us here.

about_feria_2.text: I'm a scholar myself, so I'll admit I'm here as much to look for something to write about as to look at the fair itself.

role.text: No official role, really - I'm not running an exhibit like some of the others here. I'm a visitor, same as you, though I come at it as a scholar: following what they call the path of knowledge, hoping something here sparks the next thing I write.

choices.text: A scholar? What do you normally write about?

writes_about.text: Mostly the old chroniclers and inventors - men like Daaxagoras and Pitaglorias, who put together the first atlas of this world, or travelers like Darnis, who sailed south and found land nobody'd mapped.

writes_about_2.text: There's also a puzzle I keep circling back to: two different histories of the very same centuries, written by different hands, that never quite agree with each other. I haven't solved that one. Might be why I keep coming to places like this, hoping something turns up that the books missed.
